chapter: Out-of-town work, Bourbon Street and recordings
title: Bourbon Street and the Paddock
summary: He first played Bourbon Street when Papa Celestin was ill, and later filled in with several bands.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: The first time I played Bourbon Street when Papa made me the offer to go in a pad off when he was taken sick. He asked me to bring a band out there. That was my first chance out there.
You played with some other bands there and I heard you with other bands.

Yeah well I played with uh, in Freddie's place in Freddie's band. Freddie Coleman had the band at the time and sometime he was, couldn't make it. I played in his place. I played with Rick when he had a band out there. I played at the paddock with several bands there. And I played with Thomas when Thomas had a band at the, what is the Club Slipper? Yeah, the Club Slipper. I played there. Which Thomas? Thomas Jefferson. When he had a band I played with him.
